description: This file defines the TwilioSmsProvider class, which implements SMS sending functionality using Twilio API within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It manages settings, constructs HTTP requests, and handles responses for sending SMS messages.

classes.name: TwilioSmsProvider
classes.description: A service class for sending SMS messages via Twilio API within OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SMS message using Twilio API, handling success and error cases.

methods.name: GetHttpClient
methods.description: Creates and configures an HttpClient instance with Basic Authentication headers for Twilio API.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and caches Twilio settings, unprotecting sensitive data as needed.
